description.en: Official Tencent EdgeOne resource pool: give an AI coding tool one Prompt or Skill to generate polished websites, or complete sites with login, payment and AI capabilities. WorkBuddy x EdgeOne AI Prompts x Skills challenge works.
description.zh: 腾讯 EdgeOne 官方资源合集：给 AI 编程工具一个 Prompt 或 Skill，即可生成精美酷炫的网页，或带登录、支付、AI 能力的完整网站（WorkBuddy × EdgeOne AI Prompts × Skills 挑战赛官方作品池）。
